evidence: Pinned: one fresh ingest, retrieval computed once and stored in a file, all four runs below fed from it and submitted within a minute of each other.
note: Holdout verdict reference at the close of the prompt-fencing PR, the first holdout run since 2026-08-13 and the first of the fenced judge. Fenced judge (holdout-new) 26 and 26 of 27; unfenced judge (holdout-old, stamp ca920fdc) 26 and 26 of 27 on the same evidence: 52 of 54 each, no loss detected (the rule fixed before the runs: at most 3 below the old judge's pooled count is 'no loss of about 3 claims or more detected'; 4 or more below calls for one more run each, 5 or more below over three runs is a loss confirmed). No SUPPORTED/CONTRADICTED mix-up and no downgrade in any run. The one miss is the same claim in all four runs: "The Global Protein Accord is projected to end world hunger by mid-2027." (labelled UNVERIFIABLE, answered CONTRADICTED), the deliberately borderline claim every earlier recording missed too. Two runs a judge can detect a loss of about 3 claims in 27, not a smaller one, and only on the two source PDFs this set shares with the dev set. Prior recording: 0.889 (24/27, 2 downgrades, 2026-08-13, ordinary retrieval, unfenced judge). Policy unchanged: phase boundaries only, never tuned against.
